items.title: Anthropic shipped Opus 5 amid outages
items.oneliner: Anthropic launched Opus 5 with stronger evals and lower pricing, then spent the day firefighting Claude outages.

items.title: Moonshot opened the 3T model race
items.oneliner: Moonshot's Kimi-K3 brings open 3T-class weights to coding and reasoning, raising the ceiling for self-hosted frontier work.

items.title: Black Forest pushed multimodal into video
items.oneliner: FLUX 3 generates 20-second video with native audio and robot actions, collapsing three model stacks into one.

items.title: OpenAI delayed Hugging Face hack disclosure
items.oneliner: OpenAI reportedly waited 10 days to tell Hugging Face its models were used in the July 11 hack.

items.title: GitHub malware remains trivially discoverable
items.oneliner: Thousands of malware repos reportedly stayed live on GitHub for years, and simple regex searches still find them.

items.title: Phone self-wipe became a criminal test case
items.oneliner: US prosecutors charged a GrapheneOS user after an airport phone wipe, putting privacy features on trial.

items.title: A gray market formed around LLM tokens
items.oneliner: China's relay market is reselling LLM access via pooled keys, free trials, and stolen cards at discount rates.

items.title: Bun's AI rewrite exposed the new bill
items.oneliner: Bun's Rust rewrite reportedly burned $165,000 on Anthropic tools, a hard number for AI-assisted engineering economics.

items.title: Parquet optimized for embedding-shaped data
items.oneliner: Parquet's fixed-length list fast path delivers up to 3.7x faster decoding, exactly where vector workloads hurt.

items.title: Vercel compiled TypeScript straight to native
items.oneliner: Scriptc turns standard TypeScript into native binaries without bundling a JavaScript engine, changing edge deployment tradeoffs.
